title: Total Score Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Explore how ten metric scores add up to subtotals, a total, a band, and an adoption decision, then calculate the total and decision for five resources.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the quality subtotal, reusability subtotal, total score, band, and adoption decision for each of five scored resources, with the total and the decision both correct on at least 4 of 5.
prerequisites: The terms quality subtotal, reusability subtotal, total score, score band, and adoption threshold

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: What are the two subtotals and the total?
Is any metric below the floor of 5?
commonMisconceptions: A total of 75 or more always means Adopt
A total of 50 or more always means Revise
The floor applies only to the license metric
assessmentOpportunities: A resource totals 85 and one metric is 4. What is the decision?
A resource totals 37. What is the decision?
Does a total of 75 always mean Adopt?
Does the floor apply only to the license metric?

controls.name: Ten sliders
controls.description: in explore mode, set each metric score from 0 to 10 in whole points. The start position is 5 for every metric.

controls.name: Total score box
controls.description: type a whole number from 0 to 100.

controls.name: Check
controls.description: commits the answer. Back to explore is on the results screen.
